origin.summary: The user asked to reconcile the shared GPT Pro repository analysis with current Dev and to turn accepted findings into a versioned development backlog. The review identified an unresolved public-source binary and redistribution boundary.

state.current_summary: PL-0005 is resolved in Dev for the reviewed external-binary scope: forbidden and user-authorized removable DLLs remain absent, retained allowlisted dependencies have NOTICE or owner-declaration coverage, and both the clean Release distribution gate and the actual copied-runtime EXE launch/data-root smoke passed at commit 0292656befc07a79e4e2d43ddd24d386a6b24909. claims.text: The current external-reference policy and gate do not classify every binary tracked under dll or require per-file redistribution evidence.
Some tracked legacy or commercial binaries may be unused or lack confirmed redistribution permission.

problem.impact: Unclassified public binaries create source-distribution, legal, trust, repository-size, and maintenance risk even when they are not included in the application publish output.

criteria.text: Every tracked dll file has path, length, SHA-256, direct reference, dynamic reference, build requirement, publish requirement, redistribution status, license evidence, classification, and recommended action.
A reviewed allowlist and third-party notice or manifest cover every retained binary, and license-unknown files remain blocked rather than being silently approved.
Only binaries proven unused and approved for removal are deleted; clean build and publish checks prove no required runtime file was lost, and no Git history rewrite occurs.
The repository gate fails when a new unallowlisted binary is added under dll.

evidence.observation: On 2026-08-25 the working tree contained 25 dll-tree files totaling 93,581,810 bytes. The current Dev worktree inventory records all 24 tracked DLL paths: 21 present files with physical length/SHA-256 and 3 Emgu legacy paths deleted in the worktree. Each entry records direct/dynamic reference evidence, build/publish observation, license evidence, classification, release policy, and action. WPG-CUSTOM, Vila.Core, FFmpeg, proprietary, and provenance-incomplete items are explicit blocked entries.

BuildCleanRuntime Dev passed with zero warnings and zero errors.
